newsitem.title: UK: UK meals prices lower, wary on Chicago falls.
newsitem.headline: UK meals prices lower, wary on Chicago falls.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were lower on Friday, but traders were waiting to see if the Chicago market remains down after the release of the USDA crop report.

The USDA estimated 1996 U.S. soybean production at 2.346 billion bushels, above average U.S. trade estimates of 2.287 billion bushels and higher than the U.S. government's forecast in September of 2.270 billion bushels.
"People have seen Chicago open sharply lower, but now they are waiting to see if it stays down. If it does then we could see buyers coming into our market on Monday," said a trader.
High protein soymeal was offered around two stg down, but so far traders said people were keeping clear of the material.
Only one trade was reported when palmkernel meal fetched 80 stg a tonne for spot delivery ex-store Liverpool.
